prose.summary: The product meets the rule of origin, so the CEPA rate can be claimed. The estimated saving is 10000.00 AED. Follow the checklist below to claim the preference.
prose.classification: Tariff line 73089090 covers other structures of iron or steel, and Mansha's confidence is high. Confirm the code with Indian customs or a customs broker before shipping.
prose.duty: The India-UAE CEPA provides a CEPA rate of 0%, while the normal (MFN) rate is 15% (effective 10%). The estimated saving is 10000.00 AED.
prose.origin: The rule of origin requires a change in tariff subheading (CTSH) and at least 40% value addition (VA). The final manufacture check passed because the last step was in the UAE, and the minimal operations check passed because the work went beyond simple operations. The CTSH check passed as both non-originating inputs are classified outside subheading 730890, and the VA check passed with a build-down of 45.0% against the 40% threshold on an FOB basis.

notes.text: India's origin rules and certificate form specify box 9, not box 8, so the certificate must use box 9.
The CEPA's 5‑year period governs CEPA claims, which is longer than the UAE's 3‑year minimum.
The tariff schedule prints 15%, but an exemption notification lowers the duty actually charged to 10%; the effective rate is used.
India charges duty on the assessable (CIF) value at import, so actual amounts will differ from the estimate.
CEPA rates reduce Basic Customs Duty (BCD) only. IGST, GST compensation cess, SWS and any anti-dumping or safeguard duty still apply.
The CEPA rate applies only if the product qualifies under the rules of origin and a valid certificate of origin is presented.
Mansha reads '+' in the rule as 'and' (both tests must pass); the agreement does not define '+'.
Operations and final manufacture are the exporter's own declaration.
'Direct labour cost' and 'direct overhead cost' are not defined in the agreement.
The agreement does not say whether the build-down and build-up methods use the same threshold, apart from the 5-point Ex-Works adjustment.
The agreement says box 8, but India's origin rules and certificate form say box 9; India's form governs entry into India.
UAE law sets a shorter 3-year minimum; the CEPA's 5 years governs CEPA claims.

No official page read names the Ministry of Foreign Trade as the issuer of the India CEPA certificate specifically: its service page covers preferential certificates in general, and the India-specific page is still on moet.gov.ae.

A producer in a free zone is likely not eligible for Factory Registration, because it requires a factory outside a free zone, and registration is needed before applying for the certificate of origin for India. Confirm with the Ministry of Economy and Tourism.

Electronic certificates are reportedly accepted and uploaded to India's e-Sanchit system, but this is seen only in secondary sources (CBIC Instruction 28/2022 via LiveLaw, taxmann), not the official text.
Inference: SWS is charged on the reduced BCD (no CEPA-specific text found).
Inference: anti-dumping and safeguard duties still apply (no exemption found).
